## create

Create Campaign. `POST /email-campaigns`

Create a new email campaign.

- Creates both base Campaign and EmailCampaign records - Validates provider/integration and content exist - Estimates recipient count - Optional send_rate_limit (emails per minute, 1-60000) and send_batch_size (recipients per batch, at least 1). Rejected values return HTTP 422 {code, message}: send_rate_limit_out_of_range, send_batch_size_invalid, send_pacing_unavailable.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->create(name: 'name', subjectLine: 'subject_line');
```

## update

Update Campaign. `PATCH /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}`

Update email campaign.

- Can only update campaigns in DRAFT or SCHEDULED status - Once sending/sent, campaigns are immutable -- except the send speed (send_rate_limit, emails per minute) and batch size (send_batch_size): a sending, paused or failed campaign may change ONLY these two (explicit null clears one). ## getRecipients

Get Campaign Recipients. `GET /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}/recipients`

## unsubscribeRecipient

Unsubscribe Email Campaign Recipient. `POST /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}/recipients/{recipient_id}/unsubscribe`

Opt an email recipient's contact out of this campaign's lists.

This is DISTINCT from DELETE /{campaign_id}/recipients/{recipient_id} ("Remove"), which only deletes the per-recipient row and does NOT change subscription state. This endpoint resolves the recipient's contact, computes the campaign's originating list(s) (campaign_lists on the base campaign ∩ the contact's currently-subscribed lists) and opts the contact out of all of them via the subscription chokepoint, writing the opt-out ledger with campaign attribution (method='manual'). {campaign_id} is the EmailCampaign.id (as elsewhere on this router).

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->unsubscribeRecipient(campaignId: 'campaign_id', recipientId: 'recipient_id');
```

## resume

Resume Email Campaign. `POST /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}/resume`

Resume a paused email campaign

Only a paused campaign can be resumed (anything else returns HTTP 400). Sending continues with everyone who has not been sent yet. If a send speed or batch size was saved while the campaign was paused, it applies from now on. A campaign that finished a batch (throttle_reason = "batch_complete") sends its next batch, exactly like POST /email-campaigns/{id}/send-next-batch with an empty body. A campaign sent in batches that ended as completed or failed while recipients were still waiting is re-opened the same way. HTTP 422 send_pacing_unavailable while sending at a set speed or in batches is briefly unavailable.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->resume(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:send`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailCampaign`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Campaigns/resume_email_campaign_api_v1_email_campaigns__campaign_id__resume_post)

Send Campaign. `POST /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}/send`

Send or schedule email campaign.

- If send_test=true, sends to test_emails only (TODO) - Otherwise, queues campaign to Pub/Sub for async sending - Updates campaign status to SENDING - Deducts balance upfront (prepaid model) - Send speed and batches: with a send_rate_limit and/or send_batch_size saved on the campaign, the emails go out at that speed and in batches of that size. After each batch the campaign pauses (status = "paused", throttle_reason = "batch_complete") until POST /email-campaigns/{id}/send-next-batch. A saved batch size that cannot be used returns HTTP 422 {code, message} before anything is sent (send_pacing_unavailable, send_batch_size_invalid). - HTTP 409 "This campaign is already being sent" when the campaign is already sending / throttled / paused, or a concurrent request (a second click, the scheduled send) started it first -- nothing is queued twice. HTTP 409 "This campaign was paused or cancelled while it was being prepared for sending. Refresh and try again." when that happened during the send.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->send(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:send`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$sendTest` | `?bool` | no | Send test to specific addresses |
| `$testEmails` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Test email addresses |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `SendCampaign`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Campaigns/send_campaign_api_v1_email_campaigns__campaign_id__send_post)

## sendNextBatch

Send Next Email Batch. `POST /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}/send-next-batch`

Send the next batch of an email campaign sent in batches

Only for a campaign that finished a batch: status = "paused" with throttle_reason = "batch_complete", or one that ended as completed / failed while recipients were still waiting (it continues its unfinished batch first, if any). HTTP 422 send_pacing_unavailable while batch sending is briefly unavailable. Anything else returns HTTP 409 {"code": "campaign_not_awaiting_batch", "message": ...} (also when two requests race: only the first one sends a batch).

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->sendNextBatch(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:send`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$body` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | The request body |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailSendNextBatch`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Campaigns/send_next_email_batch_api_v1_email_campaigns__campaign_id__send_next_batch_post)

## getSendPlan

Get Email Campaign Send Plan. `GET /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}/send-plan`

Send plan of an email campaign: speed, batches and estimated duration

Read-only estimate for the campaign's audience at its saved send speed and batch size, or at the values given as query parameters (to preview a change before saving it). eta_seconds estimates the time to send everyone who is left (time paused between batches not included). pacing_available = false means send speed and batches are not available for this account yet.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->getSendPlan(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$sendRateLimit` | `?int` | no | Preview this send speed (emails per minute, 1-60000) instead of the saved one |
| `$sendBatchSize` | `?int` | no | Preview this batch size (>= 1) instead of the saved one |

Returns `SendPlan`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Campaigns/get_email_campaign_send_plan_api_v1_email_campaigns__campaign_id__send_plan_get)

## getUnsubscribes

Get Campaign Unsubscribes. `GET /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}/unsubscribes`

List recipients who opted out via THIS email campaign's unsubscribe link.

Campaign-attributed opt-outs, sourced from unsubscribe_tokens (SHARD) stamped with the email_campaign_id at send time. Ordered by unsubscribed_at DESC, paginated (page/page_size, default 25).

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->getUnsubscribes(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

- Scopes: `analytics:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$page` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no |  |

Returns `Page<AppSchemasEmailCampaignSchemaCampaignUnsubscribeItem>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Campaigns/get_campaign_unsubscribes_api_v1_email_campaigns__campaign_id__unsubscribes_get)
